hook: A 3D mantle model with a weak asthenosphere explains West Antarctica's uplift and gravity change.
summary: Ice loss in West Antarctica has lifted the bedrock and lowered gravity. The authors built rebound models with a three-dimensional, temperature-dependent mantle and an ice history from 1900 to 2020, and matched both GPS crustal motion and GRACE satellite gravity data. The same weak-asthenosphere mantle also fits million-year convection, but the ice history is a reconstruction and not a measurement.
title: Geodetic observations in West Antarctica reveal geodynamically consistent 3D mantle viscosity.
